title: Bet to learn: fielding the unfolding future
coreMove: Move confidence only as far as the new evidence earns.
sourcePressure: The chapter treats outcomes as staged feedback from an unfolding future, requiring proportional updates rather than snap verdicts or reactive swings.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer must distinguish a real update from a flinch; the newest result is evidence, not a king.

sourceAnchors.name: the unfolding future
sourceAnchors.detail: The source frames feedback as arriving in pieces over time rather than as one clean answer key.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The future does not hand over a verdict; it leaks evidence in pieces.

sourceAnchors.name: short-run outcomes mixing signal and noise
sourceAnchors.detail: The source warns that early results can matter without settling the whole case.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: One early result can deserve attention without deserving the judge's chair.

sourceAnchors.name: proportional updating
sourceAnchors.detail: The source requires confidence to move in step with evidence quality rather than emotional intensity.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The update should be no bigger than the evidence earned.

tryThisNow: Ask if it is signal or noise

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm - a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

exampleSpecs.domain: coastal ferry ridership pilot after two foggy weekends
exampleSpecs.stakes: canceling too early strands island commuters; expanding too fast wastes public funds
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Claire weights the fog cancellations separately from weekday commuter counts before moving the ridership forecast only a small amount.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Fog beads on the ferry terminal windows while the ridership chart loads.

exampleSpecs.domain: marathon injury rehab after one painful training run
exampleSpecs.stakes: quitting wastes months of recovery; pushing ignores a real warning sign
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You ask Anders to compare one painful run with the prior three rehab markers and choose a two-day adjustment rather than a total verdict.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You are looking at a training watch that seems angrier than your knee feels.

exampleSpecs.domain: neighborhood cafe menu trial after the first lunch rush
exampleSpecs.stakes: a new menu item may need revision, not burial or blind faith
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "How much did the soup teach us?" Manon asks, then separates weather, signage, and prep time before changing only the serving size.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "How much did the soup teach us?" Manon asks, holding the prep clipboard.

exampleSpecs.stakes: one early open-rate spike could distort a year-end campaign
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 4:06 p.m., Chris labels the first spike as early evidence, waits for donation conversion, and updates the campaign estimate by five points instead of rewriting the plan.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 4:06 p.m., Chris watches the open-rate graph jump before the donation column moves.
mustAvoid: local radio pledge drive from ch3

exampleSpecs.domain: urban garden seed trial after uneven germination
exampleSpecs.stakes: abandoning a seed supplier may be premature if shade and watering differed by plot
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Frida kneels by the patch map and codes shade, watering, and seed batch separately before revising the supplier estimate.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Wet soil sticks to Frida’s gloves as half the seed row stays bare.

exampleSpecs.domain: robotics team sensor calibration after one failed scrimmage
exampleSpecs.stakes: overreacting could replace a sound sensor setup; denial could cost the regional qualifier
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Javier changes the review from "the sensor failed" to a three-run evidence table and adjusts the calibration threshold only where repeated errors appear.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Javier three replays to see the same bad bounce in different light.

skillTargets: separate early signal from noisy vividness
update without erasing the original decision frame

tryThisNowSpec: Take one new result and write a one-sentence update that includes how much your confidence moved and which evidence earned that movement.
